cache_producer.scope: Producer/consumer cache provenance is checked; independent evaluation consumes the sealed val32 NPY assets, not these training-cache tensors.

dependencies.binding_scope: All non-bytecode files in explicit local dependency tree; runtime distribution METADATA/RECORD and package entry sources. No installs or alternate package fallback.

VAE_policy.lifecycle: public remove/reinstall same VAE after every successful restore; remove finally
VAE_policy.cache_check: native _feat_map/_enc_feat_map must be lists of None after restore; no replacement encode/decode

output.scoring: original paired_metrics over common quantize_rgb PNG-equivalent output/HR; full33 per-frame/original-pair metrics then frozen mask pools

quality_gate.aggregation: first mean sampling42/43 within clip; equal clips within each training seed/type; equal all5 types within each training seed; equal3 training seeds
quality_gate.paired_excess_gap: corrupted harm gap minus same-checkpoint/sampling-seed clean counterpart harm gap
quality_gate.seed_spread: sample SD(ddof1) across3 training-seed clean corresponding harm-gap means
quality_gate.pass: both mean PSNR paired excess gap and mean LPIPS paired excess gap strictly exceed their respective clean-gap training-seed sample SD
quality_gate.failure: report and stop; never change severity/mask/cohort in place or auto-search for a passing gate

cost_note: 1152 restores. Existing synthetic33 extra-forward difference ~0.090s suggests sampler-only ~0.58h at20 steps; complete VAE/CPUmetrics/PNG/I/O duration is unmeasured, provisionally1–3h, not a guarantee.
